chunks: He said, 'I will ask my Lord to forgive you,' for He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Joseph say to his brothers regarding forgiveness?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (Yusuf) declares his intention to seek forgiveness for his brothers, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on his role as a mediator of divine mercy. By invoking the attributes Al-Ghafur and Al-Rahim, the verse underscores the accessibility of repentance and the continuity of prophetic intercession within the broader narrative of divine forgiveness.
